metadata.description: Example C SCD Assignment: slot 1, 1600 W budget, CONN0 split x4x4. Deliberately omits ocp.link_subdivision.conn2.pcie_primary even though it is marked required -- the declared x16 default is what this platform wants. Also omits both vendor fields, so pen.32473.stream_image_slot is not applicable and would have been ignored had it been supplied.
